details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: CPU exhaustion via malformed DNSKEY records
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-8677.patch: fail validation on invalid DNSKEY
       in lib/dns/validator.c.
     - CVE-2025-8677
   * SECURITY UPDATE: cache poisoning through forged records in answers
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-40778.patch: tighten resolver caching rules
       in lib/dns/resolver.c and lib/dns/message.c, and raise the default
       max-recursion-queries from 32 to 50 in bin/named/config.c.
     - CVE-2025-40778
   * SECURITY UPDATE: assertion failure on malformed PRIVATEDNS DNSKEY records
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-10822.patch: make dns_name_fromwire() honour
       the active region of the source buffer in lib/dns/name.c.
     - CVE-2026-10822
   * SECURITY UPDATE: crash from malformed NSEC/NSEC3 response
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-13204.patch: treat a missing NOQNAME proof as
       an error instead of an assertion failure in lib/dns/rbtdb.c,
       lib/dns/resolver.c and lib/ns/query.c.
     - CVE-2026-13204
   * SECURITY UPDATE: forged DNSSEC-validated NXDOMAIN responses
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-19941.patch: require NSEC wildcard proofs to
       be signed by the same zone as the NOQNAME proof in
       lib/dns/validator.c and lib/dns/include/dns/validator.h.
     - CVE-2026-19941
   * SECURITY UPDATE: DNSSEC validation bypass via NSEC3 impersonation
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-10723.patch: check that the NSEC3 signer
       matches the owning zone in lib/dns/dnssec.c and lib/isc/result.c.
     - CVE-2026-10723
   * SECURITY UPDATE: excessive CPU use validating crafted DNSSEC responses
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-19668.patch: bound the DS-to-DNSKEY matching
       during DNSSEC validation and make the exhausted quota terminal in
       lib/dns/validator.c and lib/dns/resolver.c.
     - CVE-2026-19668
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free of cached NOQNAME proofs
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-19662.patch: keep the cache slabheader that
       owns a NOQNAME or closest-encloser proof referenced while the proof
       rdatasets are in use in lib/dns/rbtdb.c.
     - CVE-2026-19662
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-zone data above the apex treated as a zone cut
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-78301.patch: ignore nodes above the zone
       origin in RBT zone database lookups in lib/dns/rbtdb.c.
     - CVE-2026-78301
   * SECURITY UPDATE: sparsely signed incoming zone transfers accepted
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-19033.patch: require a TSIG on every message
       of an incoming zone transfer in lib/dns/xfrin.c.
     - CVE-2026-19033
   * SECURITY UPDATE: memory amplification via duplicate singleton records
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-75029.patch: skip duplicate singleton
       records when parsing DNS messages in lib/dns/message.c.
     - CVE-2026-75029
   * SECURITY UPDATE: DNSSEC downgrade of secure delegations via NSEC3
     from an unrelated sibling zone
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-77119.patch: ignore NSEC3 records whose owner
       zone does not enclose the DS name in the insecure delegation proof
       in lib/dns/validator.c.
     - CVE-2026-77119
   * SECURITY UPDATE: invalid signed wildcard records accepted
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-11721.patch: reject RRSIG records whose labels
       field is lower than the signer label count when parsing and
       verifying in lib/dns/rdata/generic/rrsig_46.c and lib/dns/dnssec.c,
       and do not sign out-of-zone records in bin/dnssec/dnssec-signzone.c.
     - CVE-2026-11721
